Creative Coaches
Creative Coaches

Learning
to Create.
Learning
to Lead.

Art education is not simply about making things — it is about learning how to think, adapt, and lead.

What Art Education Builds

  • Art trains the creativity and critical thinking that no technology can replace.
  • Students learn to observe deeply and solve problems with genuine originality.
  • Studio experiences build the confidence to collaborate and communicate ideas powerfully.
  • Making art teaches students to navigate uncertainty and embrace iteration as growth.
  • Art becomes the vehicle for future-ready skills that serve students in every area of life.

Creative Coaches Creative Coaches

The Role of a Creative Coach

Creative
Coaches

Shaping what’s possible

Beyond instruction — creating the conditions for students to discover their voice, build confidence, and develop the inner resources to lead.

Artistic
Inspirational
Transformational

Three Dimensions of Development

01 · Artistic
Technical mastery as a foundation for expression.
Coaches guide students through drawing, composition, color, and material — building the craft skills that give creative ideas a form they can share with the world.
02 · Inspirational
Igniting curiosity, confidence, and creative courage.
Every session is designed to spark wonder — helping students see that their ideas matter and their voice is worth hearing.
03 · Transformational
Growth that reaches far beyond the studio.
Art is the method. Transformation is the mission — a student who thinks clearly, leads boldly, and meets uncertainty with resilience.

Three Layers of Learning — Every Session

Layer 01 · Art Skills
How students create

How students think
Resilience

Creative Confidence

Critical Thinking

Emotional Intelligence

Layer 03 · Real-World Transfer
How students lead
Problem-Solving

Communication

Adaptability
Navigating change with composure
Leadership
Inspiring through vision

Alexandra May
Creative Coach · Visual Artist

Meet Your Creative Coach

Building creative confidence,
one canvas at a time

Drawing · Painting · Design Thinking · CSULB Fine Arts

Coach Allie uses drawing and painting as vehicles for developing the skills students carry into every corner of their lives — creative confidence, sharp observation, self-expression, and independent thinking. Through a balance of technical foundations and open-ended exploration, her students learn to communicate ideas visually, take creative risks, and grow stronger through each iteration.

Creative Coach · Animator · 3D Artist

Meet Your Creative Coach

From imagination to motion,
frame by frame

Animation · 3D Modeling · Creative Technology · MICA BFA

Coach Angela uses animation and 3D modeling to develop spatial reasoning, systems thinking, creative problem-solving, and visual communication. With a BFA in Animation from MICA and experience as a freelance gameplay animator and 3D artist, she brings real creative industry practice into every session.

Creative Coaches

Our Belief

Every child carries
a creative voice
worth developing.

Creativity is not a talent.

It is a capacity — and it

belongs to every student.

Our Mission in Practice

One unified approach

Through the three-layer teaching model — art skills, life skills, and real-world transfer — every Creative Coaches session cultivates thinkers, communicators, and leaders.

A growing team, one dream

Our coaches bring expertise across drawing, painting, animation, 3D modeling, illustration, storyboarding, and visual storytelling. Different backgrounds, different mediums — every coach guided by the same conviction.

Coach Allie · Drawing & Painting
Coach Angela · Animation & 3D
Coach Brittany · Illustration & Story
“We don’t just teach art.
We develop the people art makes possible.”
